label: There is at most one maximum in being: any two beings that are…, via attribution unique maximum
meaning: On the reading by attribution there is at most one maximum in being, from the order of being by approach to a primary (q.3 a.5 ad 2) and strict primacy (open, unattributed), by excluded middle; neither the genus principle nor Metaphysics II.1 is used (contrast AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-AT-MOST-ONE-MAXIME-ENS). A countermodel with tied degrees shows that strict primacy is needed: the order by approach with 'nothing exceeds the primary' does not give uniqueness.
